plain: You get 1.5 points for every dollar you spend on regular purchases, 3 points per dollar when you eat out, and 4 points per dollar on streaming services. On top of that, you get 60,000 extra points if you spend $4,000 within your first 3 months.
alt: Rack up 1.5 points per dollar on everyday spending, triple points at restaurants, and quadruple points on streaming. And when you spend $4,000 in your first 3 months, a 60,000-point welcome bonus is yours.
frame_flip: Don't leave points on the table: miss out on 1.5 points per dollar on everyday purchases, 3x on dining, and 4x on streaming no longer. And don't lose the 60,000-point welcome bonus you get when you spend $4,000 in your first 3 months.
reordered: Get a 60,000-point welcome bonus when you spend $4,000 in your first 3 months. Plus, earn 4x points on streaming, 3x points on dining, and 1.5 points per dollar on everyday purchases.
